project: Murali Resort | Premium Resort & Convention Center
auditor: AI Website Design Auditor & Remediation Engine (Floto Workflow)

findings.title: Visible text not included in accessible name on hero scroll button
findings.observedBehavior: The visible text is 'Scroll to explore', but aria-label overrides it with 'Skip scroll animation and view venue details'.
findings.whyItMatters: Speech-to-text / speech-recognition users speaking 'Click Scroll to explore' cannot trigger the button because the accessible name differs entirely from the visible text.
findings.proposedFix: Update aria-label to 'Scroll to explore — skip animation and view venue details' so the accessible name begins with the visible label.
findings.expectedResult: Accessible name contains visible text, passing WCAG 2.5.3.

findings.title: Visible label mismatch in accessible name for spaces catalog link
findings.htmlExcerpt: View All Spaces...
findings.observedBehavior: Visible text is 'View All Spaces', while aria-label is 'View all resort spaces and facilities'.
findings.whyItMatters: Voice navigation users who speak the visible label encounter mismatched speech matching in assistive software.
findings.proposedFix: Update aria-label to 'View All Spaces and facilities' or rely on the natural text content.
findings.expectedResult: Accessible name begins with visible text 'View All Spaces'.

findings.title: Insufficient color contrast on active navigation capsule link
findings.htmlExcerpt: Facilities
findings.observedBehavior: Element has contrast ratio of 3.21:1 (#c4a984 on #585756 navbar blur capsule), below the required 4.5:1 threshold for 14px text.
findings.whyItMatters: Users with low vision or browsing in high ambient sunlight cannot clearly distinguish active page indicators.
findings.proposedFix: Use high-contrast text color #F5EBE0 or #FFFFFF with an active gold underline indicator, achieving contrast > 5.5:1.
findings.expectedResult: Contrast ratio exceeds 4.5:1 against the capsule background.

findings.title: Dead 'Celebrations' navigation link caused by preventDefault
findings.observedBehavior: Clicking 'Celebrations' in the header navigation, mobile drawer, or footer has e.preventDefault() attached, doing nothing.
findings.whyItMatters: Visitors attempting to view wedding and celebration event offerings click the link and experience a broken, dead control.
findings.proposedFix: Point the link to '/home#moments' (the authentic Celebration Moments showcase) and remove e.preventDefault().
findings.expectedResult: Clicking 'Celebrations' smoothly navigates to the Celebration Moments section across all pages.

findings.title: Desktop navigation links have tap/click target height below 24px
findings.observedBehavior: Nav links have zero vertical padding, resulting in bounding box heights of 16px to 20px.
findings.whyItMatters: Users with motor impairments or using touch-screen laptops find it difficult to activate links without accidental misclicks.
findings.proposedFix: Add py-2 to navigation links to provide an ergonomic 36px–40px target height.
findings.expectedResult: Target height meets or exceeds 24px requirement.

findings.title: TextReveal component omits space characters in DOM text content
findings.htmlExcerpt: <TextReveal text="See our spaces in person" /> -> DOM textContent is 'Seeourspacesinperson'
findings.observedBehavior: Words are split and rendered with paddingRight: 0.25em but without a whitespace character, causing text content to run together without spaces.
findings.whyItMatters: Breaks text selection, browser copy-pasting, screen reader text parsing, and search indexing.
findings.proposedFix: Insert a whitespace character or {' '} between word spans in TextReveal.tsx.
findings.expectedResult: DOM textContent preserves standard word spaces.

findings.title: Robotic jargon and developer implementation notes in Enquiry status screen
findings.htmlExcerpt: Automated background email delivery is currently in setup mode (missing server-side SMTP/CRM provider). To guarantee your dates are locked in without delay, transmit your enquiry directly to our reservation concierge:
findings.observedBehavior: Exposes raw developer infrastructure details ('missing server-side SMTP/CRM provider') and robotic phrasing ('transmit your enquiry').
findings.whyItMatters: Damages the premium, luxury resort brand voice and confuses guests looking to book an event.
findings.proposedFix: Rewrite to: 'Your enquiry has been prepared and is ready to send. To receive an immediate response and confirm available dates, connect directly with our reservation concierge via WhatsApp or phone:'

findings.title: Inconsistent rectangular submit button in Enquiry form
findings.htmlExcerpt: <button type="submit" class="w-full sm:w-auto min-h-[48px] px-10 py-3.5 bg-premium-dark text-white uppercase tracking-wider text-xs sm:text-sm ...">Submit Enquiry</button>
findings.observedBehavior: Submit button is rectangular with square corners, unlike the rounded-full button system used throughout the site.
findings.whyItMatters: Breaks visual design consistency and cohesive brand styling.
findings.proposedFix: Add rounded-full to match Tier 1 primary buttons.
findings.expectedResult: Button conforms to unified design system.

findings.title: Inactive stacked facility panels exposed to screen readers
findings.observedBehavior: On desktop, 6 sticky facility panels are stacked in the DOM. Inactive slides have opacity: 0 but remain in the accessibility tree, exposing 12 h2 elements.
findings.whyItMatters: Screen reader users navigating by headings hear invisible duplicate facility descriptions.
findings.proposedFix: Add aria-hidden={!isActive} to the inactive facility slides.
findings.expectedResult: Only the currently active facility slide is announced.

findings.title: Interactive Leaflet marker touch target size below 24px
findings.observedBehavior: Custom Leaflet marker icon container has a 12x12px hit box.
findings.whyItMatters: Violates WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target size of 24x24px.
findings.proposedFix: Expand marker interactive container to min-w-[32px] min-h-[32px].
findings.expectedResult: Hit area meets WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target size.
